g.text: Temporal evolution | IEEE Xplore + Scopus + Web of Science
IEEE Xplore + Scopus + Web of Science: arithmetic sums; cross-database duplicates retained.
Historical query families differ in scope. U indicates search terms, not verified uncertainty treatment.
Complete calendar years through 2025; incomplete 2026 excluded.
General DT searches are domain-independent; S1–S5 searches concern the study context.
